transport_policy.description: derived (the default): transport follows convention and `transport` is the last one that worked. pinned: `transport` is the only one tried.

forge_hosts.description: Hosts on which this machine treats HTTPS and SSH spellings as one tap identity, in addition to the built-in forge hosts (RFC-MASK-0022). A project file can never set this.

$comment: Machine configuration v3 (RFC-MASK-0021): every skill source is a tap. There is no live source block and no legacy_source. Repository is a normalized credential-free HTTPS, SSH or local file identity; transport must match it; cache and authoring are machine-local absolute paths. An authoring checkout is for publishing and explicit dev-link only. line_endings (MASK-0109 amendment) is the tap's byte policy: exact, or absent in an entry written before it existed, keeps exact bytes; autocrlf is the explicit tap add --autocrlf opt-in to Git core.autocrlf=true conversion of authoring bytes. tap add and doctor --migrate write it. Runtime additionally validates URI/ref/path safety and catalog ownership. Versions 1 and 2 remain readable.
